title: Radisson Rally
style: Jazz swing, fast beat and syncopated with walking bass, brushed drums, piano riffs, and guitar comping; verse rides a playful storytelling groove, pre-chorus tightens into clipped scats, chorus snaps into a chanty swing hook; vocals are close-mic with playful doubles, light scat fills, and quick call-and-response ad-libs; ear candy includes stick clicks, rim taps, handclap accents, and a short turnaround flourish between sections; mix is bright, lively, and punchy with a vintage club sparkle., jazz, exciting, swing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Radisson came, and the ball took flight
Forehand cross, then a backspin bite
One more lob, then a net-side tease
They chased that thing like a summer breeze

It kissed the tape, then spun away
Somehow stayed up, somehow still play
A slice, a block, then a reach, then more
The whole crowd leaned to the center floor

[Pre-Chorus]
Could’ve ended right there
Could’ve ended again
But they kept it alive
Round and round, my friend

[Chorus]
That rally, that rally
Nobody could call it done
That rally, that rally
Till the impossible run
(Radisson rally)
One shot after one
That rally, that rally
What a point they spun

[Verse 2]
A dink to the kitchen, a soft reply
Then a flick to the corner, way up high
A paddle went low, then a shoulder twist
And somehow the winner still got missed

They stretched for it, all across the lane
Backhands flying like summer rain
Every swing said, “Not yet, not now”
Then somehow the point kept breathing out

[Pre-Chorus]
Could’ve ended right there
Could’ve ended again
But they kept it alive
Round and round, my friend

[Chorus]
That rally, that rally
Nobody could call it done
That rally, that rally
Till the impossible run
(Radisson rally)
One shot after one
That rally, that rally
What a point they spun

[Bridge]
Then came that reach
That nobody thought
A dead-still ball
Still somehow caught
They froze, then laughed
Like “Did you see?”
Everybody knew
That was the one to beat

[Chorus]
That rally, that rally
Nobody could call it done
That rally, that rally
Till the impossible run
(Radisson rally)
One shot after one
That rally, that rally
What a point they spun

[Outro]
Hands went up
Heads shook slow
All four smiled
Like they’d seen a show
Proud of the chase
Amazed by the play
They laughed, they nodded
And walked away
